blocks.text: Evening Prayer for the New Year

City, and the memory of all Thy people, the House of Israel, for deliverance and for happiness, for favour and for grace and for compassion, for life and for peace on this Day of Remembrance. Remember us, O Lord our God, on it for happiness, consider us on it for blessing and help us on it unto life, and through the word of salvation and compassion, spare us and be gracious unto us, have compassion upon us, and help us, for towards Thee our eyes are turned, for Thou O God, art a gracious and merciful King.

Our God and God of our fathers, reign over the whole world in Thy glory and rise above the whole earth in Thy grandeur. Shine forth in the exalted beauty of Thy might upon all the inhabitants of the territory of Thine earth so that every creature may recognize that Thou hast created it and that every form may understand that Thou hast formed it and all with breath in the nostrils may say: The Lord, the God of Israel, is King and His Kingdom rules over all. Sanctify us through Thy commandments and grant our portion in Thy Torah, satisfy us with Thy goodness and gladden us with Thy help and purify our heart to serve Thee in truth for Thou, O Lord, art truth and Thy word is truth and endures for ever. Blessed art Thou, O Lord King over the whole earth, who sanctifies Israel and the Day of Remembrance.

Take delight, O Lord our God, in Thy people Israel and in their prayer and restore the service to the sanctuary of Thy House and accept with love and favour the fire offerings of Israel and their prayer, and may the service of Thy people Israel be a perpetual delight.
And may our eyes behold when Thou returnest to Zion in compassion. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who restores His majesty to Zion.

We thank Thee for Thou art the Lord our God and the God of our fathers for ever and ever. The Rock of our life, the Shield of our salvation art Thou from generation to generation.
